hooks.command: input=$(cat);sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id');msg=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // empty' | head -n1);title=$(jq -r --arg sid "$sid" 'select(.sessionId==$sid) | .name' ~/.claude/sessions/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n1);title=${title:-Claude Code};read -ra words <<< "$msg";spoken="${words[*]:0:4}";osascript -e "display notification $(printf '%s' "$msg" | jq -Rs .) with title $(printf '%s' "$title" | jq -Rs .)";say "$spoken"

sid=$(jq -r '.session_id');title=$(jq -r --arg sid "$sid" 'select(.sessionId==$sid) | .name' ~/.claude/sessions/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n1);title=${title:-Claude Code};osascript -e "display notification \"Claude permission needed\" with title $(printf '%s' "$title" | jq -Rs .)";say 'Claude permission needed'

input=$(cat);sid=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id');msg=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.message // "Claude notification received"');title=$(jq -r --arg sid "$sid" 'select(.sessionId==$sid) | .name' ~/.claude/sessions/*.json 2>/dev/null | head -n1);title=${title:-Claude Code};read -ra words <<< "$msg";spoken="${words[*]:0:4}";osascript -e "display notification $(printf '%s' "$msg" | jq -Rs .) with title $(printf '%s' "$title" | jq -Rs .)";say "$spoken"
